description: This source file defines data structures and parsing logic for 'TalkDirective' configurations in a speech or voice-related application. It includes structs for representing directives and parse results, and an enum with a static method for parsing JSON-encoded directives from text, extracting relevant parameters and handling unknown keys.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a text string to extract a TalkDirective if present, normalizing and processing JSON data within the string, and returning a result with the directive, a stripped version of the input, and any unknown keys.
